scope: training sources of the frozen JATOBÁ v1.1 checkpoint (NorDecision v1.1, best step 5000) and its frozen encoder
method: fresh primary-source review: Hugging Face card YAML and Hub API at the pinned revisions; authors' GitHub LICENSE/README; official project pages; task papers. Evidence file SHA-256 below. Not legal advice.

sources.author: Itaú Unibanco / ICTi
license_evidence: card YAML `license: cc-by-nc-sa-4.0` at the pinned revision
Hub API tag license:cc-by-nc-sa-4.0 at the pinned revision
sources.training_permitted: fine-tuning/derivation allowed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms (NonCommercial, ShareAlike)
sources.weight_restriction: derived weights must stay NonCommercial and ShareAlike (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 or compatible)
sources.attribution: credit Itaú Unibanco, link the model and license, cite the NorBERTo paper (card citation block)
sources.implication: sets the floor for JATOBÁ weights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial

sources.author: Magurofg (localization); Amazon (MASSIVE, https://huggingface.co/datasets/AmazonScience/massive)
license_evidence: card YAML `license: cc-by-4.0`
card text: 'Derivado do MASSIVE © Amazon.com, sob CC-BY-4.0; esta localização mantém a licença.'
AmazonScience/massive card: cc-by-4.0
sources.training_permitted: CC BY 4.0 permits adaptation for any purpose; no training restriction stated
sources.attribution: cite MASSIVE (FitzGerald et al., 2022) and the localization repository (requested on the card)
sources.implication: license terms are compatible with the proposed weight license; provenance needs clarification
sources.ambiguity: The pt-BR text is not Amazon's: it was produced by an unnamed 'LLM teacher' from the pt-PT split. The generating model and its output terms are not identified in the card or in the author's public repositories (the linked repository MaxxArtes/pocket-lm returns 404). Terms of that model are unknown.

sources.author: Livy Real, Erick Fonseca, Hugo Gonçalo Oliveira (ASSIN 2 organizers)
license_evidence: HF card YAML `license: unknown`; 'Licensing Information: [More Information Needed]'
official site https://sites.google.com/view/assin2/ and /english: no license, terms or permission statement; data on Google Drive
task paper (CEUR-WS Vol-2583): the only CC BY 4.0 notice reads 'Copyright © 2020 for this paper by its authors' — it covers the paper, not the corpus
evaluation-script repository https://github.com/erickrf/assin: MIT, covers the scripts only; no data
ASSIN 2 is built on SICK-BR (https://github.com/livyreal/SICK-BR @ 82ddaec6): no license file or statement
SICK-BR translates SICK (Marelli et al., 2014), distributed under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (https://zenodo.org/records/2787612; https://marcobaroni.org/composes/sick.html)
sources.training_permitted: training use documented as the purpose of the shared task; no written license
sources.weight_restriction: no explicit clause either permitting or restricting redistribution of trained weights
sources.attribution: cite Real et al. (2020); the SICK root requires attribution and is NonCommercial-ShareAlike
sources.implication: formal license unspecified; weights released under a documented human risk acceptance (see release_decision)
sources.ambiguity: Public download, the Apache header of loader code, and third-party models trained on ASSIN 2 were not treated as permission. Upstream SICK is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, which would be compatible with a non-commercial share-alike release, but the ASSIN 2 additions and annotations carry no license at all.
research_use_evidence: official page (sites.google.com/view/assin2) publicly distributes train, validation and test data via direct links
task paper: 'ASSIN 2 offered the interested community a new benchmark for computational semantic tasks in Portuguese'
task paper acknowledgements: annotators took part 'with the single purpose of producing open resources for the community interested on the computational processing Portuguese'
task paper: participating teams trained models on the ASSIN 2 train collection (e.g. BERT fine-tuned 'with ASSIN 1 (train and test) and ASSIN 2 (train) data')

sources.author: Bencke, Pereira, Santos, Moreira (LREC-COLING 2024)
license_evidence: original repository LICENSE: MIT (repository contains train/val/test CSVs)
mirror card YAML `license: mit`
sources.applies_to: repository contents including the data files
sources.training_permitted: MIT grants use, modification and distribution without restriction
sources.attribution: keep the MIT notice; cite Bencke et al. (2024)
sources.ambiguity: MIT is a software license applied here to data; the premises' own provenance was not independently audited.

sources.author: Leite, Silva, Bontcheva, Scarton (AACL 2020)
license_evidence: README: 'ToLD-Br is licensed under a Creative Commons BY-SA 4.0 license' (LICENSE_ToLD-Br.txt, full CC BY-SA 4.0 legal code)
code separately MIT (LICENSE_code.txt)
HF card JAugusto97/told-br: cc-by-sa-4.0
sources.training_permitted: adaptation permitted under ShareAlike; the authors themselves distribute a model fine-tuned on ToLD-Br (README 'Trained Model')
sources.attribution: credit the authors, link the license, indicate changes; cite Leite et al. (2020)
sources.implication: compatible with a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 weight release if ShareAlike reaches the weights; not a blocker
sources.ambiguity: Neither the license nor the authors state whether trained weights are Adapted Material. This audit does not decide that question. Tweets are also subject to platform terms.

sources.author: Vargas, Carvalho, Góes, Pardo, Benevenuto (LREC 2022)
sources.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (authors' repository); the HF card says apache-2.0
license_evidence: GitHub LICENSE: 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International (CC BY-NC 4.0)'
GitHub README: 'This dataset is licensed under ... (CC BY-NC 4.0)' and 'intended for research purposes only. Commercial use is not permitted.'
HF card (same author) YAML: apache-2.0 — conflicting; the stricter authors' statement is adopted
sources.training_permitted: non-commercial use; README says research purposes only
sources.attribution: credit the authors; cite Vargas et al. (2022)
sources.implication: weights must be non-commercial; a research-only, non-commercial release is consistent with the stated intent
sources.ambiguity: The license statements conflict (HF Apache-2.0 vs GitHub CC BY-NC 4.0). The 'research purposes only' sentence is narrower than CC BY-NC itself; confirming that a public non-commercial weight release is acceptable to the authors would remove doubt.

card section 'License: This dataset is licensed under CC-BY 4.0.'

sources.attribution: cite the two BRIGHTER papers listed on the card

sources.author: Zhang et al. (Meta; ICLR 2026)
license_evidence: card: 'Community Alignment is released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC-BY-4.0).'
card 'Usage': 'Users must implement appropriate filtering and moderation measures when utilizing this dataset for training purposes' — training use is explicitly contemplated
sources.attribution: cite Zhang et al. (2026) as given on the card
sources.ambiguity: The card asks users to filter annotator-initiated prompts for their own content standards; no consent or privacy terms beyond the card were reviewed, and none are claimed here.

release_decision.scope: JATOBÁ v1.1 model weights only, under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; does not authorize redistribution of ASSIN 2 text (benchmark policy stays REBUILD_FROM_UPSTREAM_ONLY)
release_decision.note: a human release decision, not a legal clearance; the ASSIN 2 license ambiguity remains and is disclosed
